name: INSPIRE (STEM research for NC students)
org: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics (NCSSM)
what_you_do: A one-week program where you stay on campus. You are matched with a mentor for a STEM project or research. You build leadership skills. On the last day, you share your results with families.
who_can_apply: North Carolina residents. The page does not list grade levels. It wants students with strong school skills from many walks of life.
deadline_text: 2026 portal opened Jan 6 and closed March 5, 2026. Summer 2027 applications open January 6, 2027. No 2027 close date posted yet.
how_to_apply: Online application through the INSPIRE page. Contact inspire@ncssm.edu or 919-416-2784.
notes: Held at NCSSM-Morganton in western NC, not in the Triangle. Dates are last year's.
